memo: Validation only, CPU, no submit. e2gpu-2 (base 0.420 + MMP 100 / 2-step 20 / FP parents 10) scored LB 0.413, while the class-3 simulation (truth removed from the pool) promised +0.178 MRR on class 3 (~+0.1 LB). The simulation is too easy: the truth's near copies stay in train as MMP parents. Here every MMP parent (spectral or FP) with Tanimoto >= 0.7 to the truth is dropped (a 'novel truth'), same MMP settings as e2gpu-2, fold0 NP molecules, base lists only. Logs the distribution of the best parent-truth Tanimoto and MRR@25 with / without MMP rows. If the MMP gain collapses, the class-3 generator needs farther jumps (the next component); if it survives, the hidden class 3 differs in another way.
message: e2hard-1: class-3 sim with near parents (Tanimoto >= 0.7) removed
